jdk.why: JDK 21 is the build JDK and the newest Java any pin needs: Mojang version JSON javaVersion.majorVersion is 21 for 1.21.1 and 1.21.11; Fabric API for 1.21.x requires java >=21; NeoForge 21.x targets Java 21
jdk.by_game_version_why: the harness starts each game version's servers on the Java major from that version's Mojang version JSON (17 for 1.20.1); running 1.20.1 on a newer JDK is not assumed

vineflower.use: Tier B decompiler only (the project's default decompiler, docs/architecture.md); never runs in Tier A

server_mappings.license: Mojang mappings header: development use only, no redistribution of the complete unmodified file; fetched at runtime, never vendored or committed

client_mappings.why: the client mapping set covers client-only classes that mods reference; the remapper needs it even though the harness runs servers

notes: Game versions 1.21.1 and 1.21.11 come from docs/research/game-versions.json (tools/research_versions.py): the two most-downloaded 1.21 minors for Fabric on Modrinth.

Mojang's latest release on 2026-11-03 is 26.3 (unobfuscated since 26.1). Both pinned versions are still obfuscated: Fabric mods ship intermediary names, NeoForge runs on Mojang official names. 1.21.11 is the last version intermediary covers.

Mojang re-publishes version JSON files from time to time (both entries show manifest time 2026-10-27). The URLs are content-addressed by sha1, so a re-publish shows up as a new manifest sha1; research_lock.py --verify reports it as drift and still checks the pinned URL and the downloads inside it.

Fabric Loader 0.20.1 is the newest stable loader for both versions; Fabric API 0.116.17+1.21.1 requires loader >=0.15.11 and 0.141.6+1.21.11 requires >=0.17.3, so one loader serves both harness servers.
Fabric API hashes are taken from the Modrinth API (sha1, sha512) and cross-checked against the Fabric maven .sha1 sidecar; both agreed on 2026-11-03.
The Fabric server launcher jar has no publisher hash (generated by meta.fabricmc.net). Its sha256 is recorded as observed; the Fabric installer jar it is built from is hash-pinned as the fallback.

NeoForge 21.11.x was beta up to 21.11.41-beta; 21.11.42 is the first stable and 21.11.48 the newest stable on 2026-11-03, so no beta fallback was needed. 21.1.265 is the newest 21.1.x and 21.1.x has no beta builds.

Both NeoForge installers were opened in a temp directory (deleted afterwards) to read install_profile.json and version.json: they remap the vanilla server with Mojang's server mappings (Mojang names at runtime) and ship net.fabricmc:sponge-mixin 0.16.4 (21.1.265) and 0.16.5 (21.11.48); FML is 4.0.45 and 10.0.36.
Parchment versions match the official NeoForge MDKs (NeoForgeMDKs/MDK-1.21.1-ModDevGradle and MDK-1.21.11-ModDevGradle gradle.properties).

Pack formats for reference (misode/mcmeta summary, not a publisher hash): 1.21.1 data 48 / resource 34; 1.21.11 data 94.1 / resource 75. Conversion stays within one game version, so pack.mcmeta numbers never change.

No mod JAR, game JAR, installer or mapping file is stored in the repository. Everything here is a URL plus the publisher's hash; tools/research_lock.py --verify re-checks them without downloading the large files.
1.20.1 is pinned by the owner's scope change (D-029), not by the download ranking in docs/research/game-versions.json, which still names 1.21.1 and 1.21.11.

Mojang re-published the 1.21.1 and 1.21.11 version JSONs again on 2026-11-03 (new manifest sha1s). Their pins were left as they were; research_lock.py --verify reports the drift as a warning and still checks the pinned files.

Fabric Loader 0.20.1 also serves 1.20.1 (meta.fabricmc.net lists a 1.20.1 launch profile, min Java 8). Fabric API 0.92.12+1.20.1 is the newest 1.20.1 release on Modrinth and requires fabricloader >=0.16.10 and java >=17; its Modrinth sha1 equals the Fabric maven .sha1.

NeoForge for 1.20.1 is the Forge 47.1 fork published as net.neoforged:forge with Maven versions 1.20.1-47.1.N. 1.20.1-47.1.106 is the newest build (maven-metadata.xml release). The versions API also lists a stray '47.1.82' without the game prefix, which has no artifact directory (HTTP 404) and is ignored.

Forge (MinecraftForge) pins are the 'recommended' promotions from promotions_slim.json on 2026-11-03: 47.4.28 (1.20.1), 52.1.20 (1.21.1) and 61.2.4 (1.21.11). All three game versions have a recommended build, so no 'latest' fallback was needed. Hashes are the maven.minecraftforge.net sidecars.

All four Forge-family installers (Forge 47.4.28, 52.1.20, 61.2.4 and NeoForge 47.1.106) were downloaded to a temp directory, checked against their sha256 sidecars, read for install_profile.json and version.json, and deleted. 1.20.1 renames the vanilla server to SRG member names (Mojang class names); Forge 52.1.20 and 61.2.4 rename it with Mojang's mappings. Forge 61.2.4 ships EventBus 7.0.5 and MixinExtras 0.5.4; 52.1.20 and 47.4.28 ship EventBus 6.2.33.

Quilt Loader 0.30.2 is the newest version without a pre-release suffix on meta.quiltmc.org (0.31.0-beta.5 is newer but a beta). meta.quiltmc.org lists it for all three game versions with net.fabricmc:intermediary, and its file size and hashes equal the maven.quiltmc.org sidecars. It provides fabricloader 0.19.5 to Fabric mods.

Quilt mods on 1.20.1 use QFAPI 7.7.0+0.92.2-1.20.1 (bundles QSL 6.3.0 and Fabric API 0.92.2). Modrinth lists no QFAPI or QSL release for 1.21.1 or 1.21.11 (only 1.21 alphas), so on those versions the Quilt harness uses the pinned Fabric API.
Parchment 2023.09.03 is the newest 1.20.1 release and matches the NeoForge 1.20.1 MDK (neoforged/MDK branch 1.20.1-legacy, parchment_mappings_version).
